title: speckit-dag task graph
description: A tool-neutral task dependency graph. speckit-dag produces it from Spec Kit tasks.md files; other planners can produce it too. Extra fields are allowed so producers can add their own data.

unit.description: What one node is: task (one Spec Kit task) or story (one phase or user story: a unit of work that is built and merged as one PR).

hash.description: Identifies the graph's content: the same tasks give the same hash on any commit or machine. sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces, UTF-8) of version, unit, groups, nodes and edges, leaving out ref, line, end_line and status, with task checkboxes in text read as unchecked. Progress and moved lines keep the hash; changed tasks, text, dependencies or options give a new one.

source.description: Where the graph came from, e.g. a file path.

spec.description: Where the tasks came from. Null when the input had no file, e.g. stdin.

groups.description: Phases or user stories that nodes belong to, in order.

waves.description: Node ids grouped so every node in a wave can run at the same time once earlier waves are done.

text.description: The whole section as written, heading included.

parallel.description: Marked as safe to run alongside its siblings.

status.description: todo | in_progress | done (producers may add others)

line.description: Task nodes: the task's line. Unit nodes: the phase heading's line.

kind.description: Unit nodes: setup | foundational | story | polish | other

tasks.description: Unit nodes: the tasks in this unit, in the order to do them.

ref.description: Stable address of the task: <path to tasks.md>#<task id>. Find the task by searching for its id; line is only a hint.

text.description: Task nodes: the task as written, with any indented lines under it. Unit nodes: the whole section as written.

reasons.description: Why the edge exists: explicit | phase | section | sequence | file

via.description: Unit edges: the task edges behind this edge.

spec.description: The Spec Kit feature folder. Paths are relative to the git repository root, or to the working directory outside a repository.

docs.description: Other Spec Kit documents found next to tasks.md, keyed spec, plan, research, data-model, quickstart, contracts, checklists. Folders end in /.

repo.description: The origin remote URL, without credentials.

dirty.description: True when files in the spec folder (modified, staged or untracked) differ from the commit, so a workspace cloned from the remote won't see them.

pushed.description: True when the commit is on an origin branch, as of the last fetch. False when it isn't, or there is no origin. Null when unknown.
